tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page and social-image background (Kertas).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards and panels on paper, always with a 2px line border.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card borders and dividers. Rawatlogi uses borders, not shadows.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on paper, card and teal-soft (Tinta). Dark panels in light theme.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on paper and card (7:1 light).

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Brand accent and evidence colour (Bukti): 'logi' in the wordmark, links, takeaways. Passes for small text on paper in both themes.

tokens.name: teal-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet panel for 'how it works' content; ink text on it.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Highlight (Sorot) for LARGE shapes only: a 'vs', a hook block. Never text under 24px on paper.

tokens.name: on-coral
tokens.usage: Text on coral. About 4.3:1 in light theme, so use it only at 24px+ or bold 19px+.

tokens.name: evidence-strong
tokens.usage: Fill of 'Riset kuat' and outline of 'Riset terbatas' labels.

tokens.name: on-evidence-strong
tokens.usage: Text on an evidence-strong fill (5.8:1 light, 7:1 dark).

tokens.name: evidence-concept
tokens.usage: Dashed outline and text of the 'Ilustrasi konsep' label (border 4.3:1 on paper).

tokens.name: area-rambut
tokens.usage: Rambut (hair) area label and accents; paper text on it (5.7:1).

tokens.name: area-kulit
tokens.usage: Kulit (skin) area label and the 'Belum ada riset' label; ink text on it.

tokens.name: area-gigi
tokens.usage: Gigi & mulut (teeth and mouth) area label; ink text on it.

tokens.name: area-mata
tokens.usage: Mata (eyes) area label and accents; paper text on it (7:1).

tokens.name: area-badan
tokens.usage: Badan & kuku (body and nails) area label; ink text on it.

styles.name: display-xl

styles.name: display-l

styles.name: heading

styles.usage: Running text in documents and captions on images (scale up ×2.2 on 1600-wide images).
